title: Bad Bunny Wins Best Latin at 2026 MTV VMAs for "NUEVAYoL"
detail: At the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards on Sunday, September 27, 2026 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles (hosted by Snoop Dogg), Bad Bunny won Best Latin for "NUEVAYoL," the opening track of DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS. He beat Anitta with Shakira, Fuerza Regida, KAROL G, Rosalía ft. Yahritza Y Su Esencia, Ryan Castro/Kapo/GANGSTA, and Shakira & Burna Boy. Hola! reported he did not attend the ceremony.
